data.text: Thanks, Emma—10 tons for you and 5 for me. I agree that any rotation needs everyone’s approval before becoming a regular plan. For discussion, we could each take one turn at 5 tons and one at 15 over five months, with 10 in the other three months: equal earnings of $50,000 each if we all follow it. For this month, John, are you willing to take 15 tons? We still need Kate’s and Jack’s agreement to 10 each.
